text_block_list.text:
A few days later, I decided to talk things 
over with Ikuno Dictus just the two of us 
once again.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
The summary of the plan is... to show Teio 
a winning Turbo in the All Comers...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"However, the greatest hurdle in this plan 
isn't hijacking the stage screen. Indeed—"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
How to lead Turbo-san to victory in the 
All Comers.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"It is no ordinary GII. That is because in 
this edition of the All Comers—"
Um... got a second...?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
You're Twin Turbo-san's Trainer... right? 
And then there's Ikuno-san...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"My name is Rice Shower. I just happened 
to see you, so... um..."

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I-I wanted to say hello... Since I'll be 
participating in the All Comers next 
time...
choice_data_list: I see, I'm counting on you!

I see, looking forward to working with 
you!

text_block_list.text:
I pretended not to know her... but 
naturally, I knew who she was very well.

—Rice Shower. A timid Umamusume whose 
hobby is reading picture books. But once 
the race begins—

Transforming into a terrifying "Assassin 
of the Rose." Once her sights are locked 
on a single target, she is sure to close 
in for the pass...

She was an Umamusume said to never let any 
competitor escape once she locked onto 
them—no matter how formidable they were.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Bye-bye...

Rice Shower bowed and walked away. ...A 
cold chill ran down my spine.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. The biggest key will be how to 
shake off Rice-san's relentless pursuit.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Turbo-san's front-running at the Tanabata 
Sho was certainly breathtaking. However...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"She was only able to run like that 
because Fukushima is flat. On a course 
with a hill like Nakayama Racecourse, the 
difficulty will be several times higher."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
And Rice is right behind. Unless we come 
up with a meticulous plan, we won't be 
able to win.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Do you have something... in mind?

I have a plan. However, I'm not sure if 
that alone will be enough.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I see. Actually, I have a plan of my own 
as well.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"First, could you lend a hand with my 
proposal? From today until the big day."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa, how was that, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Ikuno, why are you practicing with 
the Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Naturally, it's for the All Comers.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Yes, my secret plan is...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
My secret plan is simply "to become 
stronger."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I'm technically one of the top contenders. 
If I become even stronger, Rice-san's eyes 
will turn to me.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
If we can take Ms. Turbo out of their 
crosshairs... ...our chances of winning 
will surely increase.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
I don't really get it, but Ikuno's fired 
up too! In that case, Turbo's not gonna 
lose!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, train together with Turbo! You 
will, right?

I have to tell her. A strategy that will 
be extraordinarily difficult for Twin 
Turbo to pull off.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Eeeeh, don't run at full power~ !?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Going a bit slower on the straightaway 
midway... Does that mean slacking off?

What I instructed was to unleash the 
energy built up in the middle of the race 
past the third corner, a so-called 
"Variable Two-Stage Front-Runner" tactic.

This was the running style I had to master 
in order to stay ahead of Rice Shower.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
No no no, Turbo wants to go all out! Just 
like always, going all out without 
thinking about anything is the beeest!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Running like I did at the "Tanabata Sho" 
is way more guaranteed to make everyone 
go, "Gwwaaah?!"!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Everyone is... Ge-ge-ge...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I see...! So that's what you meant, 
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"Last time, I caught them completely off 
guard. That's why that surprise will work 
wonders this time..."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: That is your plan, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
What do you mean that surprise will pay 
off this time... Ikuno?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: In other words, it means this.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
That insane front-running at the "Tanabata 
Sho." With that performance, the other 
stables realized just how crazy Turbo 
truly is.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Matching a pace like that will only lead 
to self-destruction. That is the fear that 
haunts them...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"That's precisely why they subconsciously 
keep their distance. Even when Turbo-san 
slows the pace, they stay further back 
than necessary."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: If I fell into that kind of mental trap...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Panic all you want after the fact, but 
what's done is done... That's what you 
mean, right, Trainer?
choice_data_list: Yeah, as expected of Ikuno Dictus.
Yeah, as expected of Ikuno Dictus.

text_block_list.text:
Shift into beyond-full-power after 
throwing them off. This is probably the 
most grueling way to run for Twin Turbo.

"You cannot afford to simply run at an 
even pace. When you unleash an explosive 
burst of energy on the final stretch, 
breathing becomes excruciatingly painful."

Besides—can you endure it? Can you—enjoy 
it?

"My opponent was Rice Shower, but more 
than that, it was a battle pushing my own 
limits."

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Is Turbo... gonna do that, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Still, Turbo really wants to run with an 
empty head! Besides, maybe I won't be able 
to do it right.
Even so—
choice_data_list:
Why not give it a shot? For yourself, and 
for Teio.

Why not give it a shot? For yourself, and 
for Teio.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: For myself... and for Teio...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
That's right... Teio is about to give up. 
But Turbo... Turbo is...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
No matter how tough it gets, I'm gonna do 
it!! That's right, Turbo will never, 
ever...!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: I won't give up------!!!!!!

The engine ignited, and Twin Turbo roared. 
It was a cry of both wild instinct and 
friendship.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Alright, then Ikuno! Let's get started 
right away! Keep up with Turbo!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Yes, let us try. As many times as it 
takes.

text_block_list.name: Turbo & Ikuno
text_block_list.text: Daaaaaaaahhhhhhh!! Haaaaaaaahhhhhhh!!
choice_data_list:
Twin Turbo! Give me an even bigger 
explosion!!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Gwaaaahhhhhhhh!!

Training continues to the absolute limit. 
No, it continues—beyond the limit.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: A-A-Aaaaaaaah!!

Twin Turbo's little heart bursts into 
flames. Blood surges through her entire 
body.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
I can still go way, way, way more!! From 
here on—even more!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: TURBO EXPLOSION!!! WWOOOOOOOOHHH!!!
And so, the years flew by—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Good work, Turbo, Trainer. Lastly—let me 
tell you something important.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps something that the two of you 
haven't noticed.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Rice-san probably won't notice Turbo-san's 
strategy. Nor will the other Umamusume. 
But—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
There is only one rival who could possibly 
know. And that is—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
—It is I. You may have outwitted Rice, but 
you cannot outwit me.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I know everything inside and out. Both the 
details of our strategy, and just how 
terrifying an Umamusume Turbo-san can be.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I truly hope Ms. Turbo wins and is able to 
save Ms. Teio. However—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"I have no intention of surrendering 
victory for that purpose. You would do 
well not to lower your guard against me."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: —Well then.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
What's that supposed to mean~!? Ikuno, 
that's mean! Are you betraying Turbo~?!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Turbo won't lose! Turbo's definitely gonna 
beat Rice and Ikuno!!!

Watching their departing back... I think 
to myself. They could have kept their 
cards hidden until the very end. And 
yet...

Ikuno Dictus refused to condone it. Twin 
Turbo pouted and stayed mad at her for 
quite a while afterward.
